title: HECM Monthly Ledger Rates: Interest Method, Line Growth and Servicing Fees
content:
The monthly ledger of a Home Equity Conversion Mortgage (HECM) loan posts interest, the annual premium, servicing fees and line growth. This schedule gives the per-plan values those postings use.

| | HECM Line of Credit | HECM Tenure Payment Plan | HECM Term Payment Plan | HECM Modified Tenure Plan | HECM Modified Term Plan | HECM Fixed-Rate Single Disbursement |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Unused available line grows monthly | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | no |
| Points added to the current note rate to give the annual line growth rate | 0.50 | 0.50 | 0.50 | 0.50 | 0.50 | 0.00 |
| Monthly interest method | one twelfth of the note rate on the prior month-end balance | same | same | same | same | same |
| Rounding of every monthly accrual and fee amount | half up to the cent | half up to the cent | half up to the cent | half up to the cent | half up to the cent | half up to the cent |
| Monthly servicing fee, monthly adjustable loan on the monthly-fee option (USD) | 35.00 | 35.00 | 35.00 | 35.00 | 35.00 | 0.00 |
| Monthly servicing fee, annual adjustable or fixed-rate loan on the monthly-fee option (USD) | 30.00 | 30.00 | 30.00 | 30.00 | 30.00 | 30.00 |
| Day of the month on which the prior month's servicing fee, interest and premium post | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 |
| Servicing fee options the plan may be closed with | included in the rate; monthly fee with a servicing fee set-aside | same | same | same | same | same |

## Points of judgement

- The fee of 0.00 for a monthly adjustable loan on the HECM Fixed-Rate Single Disbursement marks a plan that cannot carry that rate type.
- A loan whose servicing is included in the rate pays no monthly fee at all; the fee amounts apply only on the monthly-fee option.
- Hypothetical: with a current note rate of 6.000 percent, the annual line growth rate on any of the five growing plans is 6.500 percent.
